editorial.description_en: Subsoil turned up by digging, darker and redder than anything on the surface.
editorial.description_ja: 掘りかえした深い土のような、濃い赤茶。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.372, C 0.082, h 36.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 濃 (koi, deep in colour) + 土 (tsuchi, earth). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Deep Earth" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 濃土. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — aki-yu at ΔE00 4.7, furu-gawara at ΔE00 5.9, sabi-iwa at ΔE00 7.7. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (216°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
